cover.title: A page for looking things up
cover.overview: Write a lookup page with a title and a small table of facts. Not a lecture.
cover.audience: New writers. Do the work in Oxygen, or on the labeled mock if the app cannot open.

blocks.body: Write a lookup page with a title and a small table of facts. Not a lecture.

blocks.heading: What today is
blocks.body: About 90 minutes. Do the lab in the app. The check at the end uses words from today only.

blocks.heading: Facts you look up
blocks.body:
Oxygen calls this a **reference**. Hours, names, sizes, part numbers. A table or a tight list. Not a speech.

You now have all three apples of the week:

1. **Concept** :  what it is
2. **Task** :  how to do it
3. **Reference** :  facts you look up

Still no booklet. Three files in a folder is enough.

items.title: Word today
items.body: **Reference** :  a page of facts a person scans, often a table.

cards.back: a page of facts a person scans, often a table

blocks.heading: Do the work
blocks.body:
This lab can fail. Fail when: There is no table, or the page is a lecture with no facts to look up, or you used a Task template.

Expected: A reference file with a small table. Clean.

blocks.intro: Walk the steps in order. Tick them in the lab after you actually do them.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.body: File > New > DITA Reference. Title: Studio hours. File: oxygen-bootcamp-work/week2/studio-hours.dita.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.body: Add one short line under the title.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.body: Insert a two-column table: Day / Hours. Four rows is enough (Mon-Thu, or similar).

steps.title: Step 4
steps.body: Do not write a story about why the studio closes on Sunday. Facts only.

blocks.summary: A reference file with a small table. Clean.

options: A lookup page with a table
blocks.why: Hours are facts you look up. That is a reference.

blocks.q: A lookup page should read like…
options: A small table or list a person can scan
blocks.why: If you need a speech, you wanted a concept. If you need steps, you wanted a task.
